text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган managed to pull off an

incredible victory, but she seems sort of
down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
I did it. Go ahead, shower me with
praise.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text: Aah... I love it when you praise me.
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
But who cares about that?! Go ahead
and praise
me! Say I did a good job!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
I won't take a single step until my tanks
are
topped up with your love!
text_block_list.name: Маяно Топ Ган

text_block_list.text:
She seems to be pouting, so I go ahead
and
comfort her for a while.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her spirits seem to have picked back up
a bit.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
